newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Schiphol not interested in stake in Duesseldorf.
newsitem.headline: Schiphol not interested in stake in Duesseldorf.

text.p: Schiphol Airport Amsterdam is not interested in taking a stake in Germany's Duesseldorf Airport, a Schiphol spokeswoman said.

The Dutch airport had applied for information concerning the possibility of buying a 50 percent shareholding in the German airport but had decided not to proceed to the bidding stage, she said. She declined to give a reason.
Duesseldorf is owned by the city and the North Rhineland regional council.
At the end of April the possibility of investing in a stake of up to fifty percent in the German airport was advertised in newspapers.
